title: Astro Loop: roguelike shooter for Android
excerpt: Astro Loop: an open-source roguelike shooter for Android. No ads, no tracking, no internet permission. A loop you can't escape.
content_html:
PubDeer presents

A roguelike shooter caught in a loop you were never meant to escape.

Incoming transmission

> DECRYPTING SIGNAL // ASTRO LOOP

Signal acquired. One ship, one pilot, a crew waiting to be recruited. The rest is out there in the dark.

System readout

CTRLSimple to Play

Steer with a single finger. Your guns fire on their own. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

SRCOpen Source

No black boxes. The whole game is open on GitHub, GPLv3.

OFFPlays Offline

Works with no signal at all. The whole game lives on your phone.

PRIVNo Ads, No Tracking

Zero internet permission. It collects nothing. Not one byte ever leaves your phone.

PERMNo Sensitive Permissions

No camera, mic, location, contacts, files or network. It never asks you for a thing.

FREEFree Forever

No price, no in-app purchases, no pay-to-win. The whole game, free.

Live Feed

content_html_zh:
PubDeer 呈现

这是一款 Roguelike 射击游戏，你永远无法逃脱。

传入传输

> 解密信号 // ASTRO LOOP

已获取信号。 一艘船，一名飞行员，一名等待招募的船员。 其余的都在黑暗中。

系统读数

CTRL简单易玩

用一根手指即可操纵。 你的枪会自行开火。 拿起容易，放下难。

SRC开源

没有黑匣子。 整个游戏在GitHub上开放，GPLv3。

OFF离线播放

完全没有信号的情况下也能工作。 整个游戏都在您的手机上。

PRIV无广告，无跟踪

零互联网许可。 它什么也不收集。 没有一个字节会离开您的手机。

PERM无敏感权限

没有摄像头、麦克风、位置、联系人、文件或网络。 它从不向你索要任何东西。

免费永远免费

没有价格，没有应用内购买，没有付费获胜。 整个游戏，免费。
